{{Top|leg}}
A '''medium pressure suit''' was a type of [[Pressure suit/Legends|pressure suit]] sometimes used by [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] individuals when they were away from the unique [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Skako/Legends|Skako]]. While similar to [[battle armor]], the suit was bulkier due to the presence of [[Pressure regulator/Legends|pressurizers]] and [[Breath mask/Legends|breathing equipment]].<ref name="PH:S">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/PHSkako|series=Planet Hoppers|text=Skako}}</ref>
